invariants.rule: Custom CUDA promotion requires reference correctness, relevant Compute Sanitizer tools, robust median/spread timing, profiler evidence, and a repeatable caller-visible win; evaluated_not_promoted is success when the experiment is sound.
CellShard remains an opaque storage, transport, placement, and residency layer and does not interpret Cellerator execution-image tile grammar.

CE-ARCH-70 hardens existing execution foundations only: no new kernel family, projection family, distributed subsystem, generic graph or tensor framework, training path, Tensor Core path, or CellShard placement implementation.
Preserve unrelated dirty work, especially the local Baseplane predicate-plan implementation; do not reset, clean, stash, overwrite, or attribute it without an ownership audit.
Prepared state owns no ordinary launch pointers; launch binding performs no allocation, device discovery, synchronization, or cold execution-image directory parsing.
Preserve CP-BP v1 and CPK1 as compatibility evidence; keep CP-Math v1 isolated as retired evidence and do not resurrect its runtime, backend, BELL, workspace, or planner ownership.

Cellerator owns execution semantics, projections, planning, and kernels; Baseplane owns sequence primitives; CellShard owns opaque persistence, placement, and transport and never interprets Cellerator tile grammar.

Semantic structure, physical projections, mutable value generations, prepared state, launch bindings, streams, and transient workspace retain distinct identities and lifetimes; pointer identity is never semantic identity.
No projection, kernel, hierarchy, fusion, or planner policy is promoted without independent correctness and end-to-end evidence in its declared regime; conventional fallbacks remain available.

CE-ARCH-40 through CE-ARCH-79 remain completed evidence for their bounded deliverables; successor work must close the broader roadmap exit criteria without rewriting or overstating those historical results.

Baseplane supplies sequence-level primitives through a small Cellerator-owned POD ABI and shares Cellerator domain, identity, relation, order, device-view, and planning concepts without depending on the full runtime.

Biological domain, exact order, semantic geometry, partition, immutable structure, structure epoch, mutable value generation, and physical projection are explicit; pointers and equal dimensions are never semantic identities.
Retain only generic reusable sparse math in Cellerator; conventional preprocessing policy and workflow ownership move to BioPrep.
Do not redesign frozen execution, planner, projection, identity, output, Baseplane, CelleraTorch, native-training, or Tensor Core contracts.
Internal execution order survives compatible producers and consumers; canonicalization is an explicit graph-visible, cacheable, hoistable, fusible, or removable operation.

Contracts accommodate transpose, backward, sparse gradients, precision plurality, graphs, persistent execution, partitions, and architecture dispatch through optional mechanisms without bloating every hot record or creating premature implementation work.
CE-GEO adds uniquely prefixed tasks, runs, decisions, interfaces, evidence, and coordination records without replacing or reopening historical project state, including CE-PTR.
CE-AMP remains blocked until CE-GEO-COMPLETE and explicit human-controlled CE-AMP-PERMISSION equals granted; no automated actor may change it.
Shape never establishes biological equivalence; domain, order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.
Preparation, conversion, transfer, value pack, input order, residual, epilogue, synchronization, canonicalization, and reuse costs remain visible.
CP-BP remains an operational sparse-oriented strategy and compatibility path, not a universal MMA representation or optimizer constraint.
CPE2 v2 header, section-entry, and projection-entry sizes remain 256, 64, and 64 bytes and existing v1 readers remain valid.
CPE2 remains the device-specific execution image and embeds the exact portable semantic geometry bytes.
CPK1 wire bytes and v1 semantics, including row_active_block_references, remain unchanged.
CSG1 contains no architecture, device, provider-kernel, matrix-instruction, pointer, stream, runtime-handle, or mutable-generation identity.
Full physical reorder and regroup freedom is the cheap default unless explicit cold caller constraints restrict it.
Behavior changes update the existing authoritative documentation spine and do not create a competing architecture.
Internal packed order may persist across compatible operations; canonicalization is explicit, justified, and costed.
One versioned data-only semantic strategy boundary is the sole future optimizer extension point; no second optimizer API or frozen binary plugin ABI is introduced.
CellShard, BioPrep, Baseplane, and adapters use only public generic Cellerator contracts and receive no privileged internal access.
Cellerator provides reusable biological operations while GlassHelix owns model architecture, loss, training behavior, latent semantics, and dynamical theory.

Sealed steady state performs no allocation, device discovery, geometry search, image parsing, descriptor construction, provider lookup, host sorting, hidden canonicalization, or device-wide synchronization.
New MMA and fusion candidates are empirical-required and cannot enter automatic normal-catalog promotion without clean complete-cost evidence.
Parallel tasks own exact files or narrow modules; shared manifests, registries, exports, and docs belong only to designated integration or documentation tasks.
Evaluated non-promotion is valid; negative results and mechanism evidence are preserved.
No biological edge is removed to satisfy structured sparsity or accelerator convenience.
New scientific provider kernels do not silently inherit global fast-math, cache-policy, register-cap, or launch-bound flags.
Work-layout optimization introduces no epoch, sampler, trainer, loss, optimizer, generic autograd, or model-policy ownership.
New CE-GEO production APIs and implementations avoid STL ownership and allocator-heavy container graphs.
WMMA fragments and architecture-private register layouts never cross public headers, provider contracts, artifacts, or mixed-architecture translation-unit boundaries.
Operand conversion, storage, accumulation, output, determinism, rounding, approximation, NaN and Inf behavior are explicit candidate policies.
Production sm_70 MMA owns output rectangles, accumulates through K, stores once, and uses no per-tile output atomics.
Physical padding has no biological identity and is never a logical work item or edge.
The existing end-to-end planner remains the sole final candidate-selection authority.
Never reset, clean, stash, overwrite, delete, silently attribute, or discard user or sibling-agent work.
Hardware and provider discovery, selection, manifest inspection, and projection activation occur before preparation and never in hot kernels.
Capability records advertise implemented source-linked code, not documented but unimplemented ISA features.
A complete exact pure-sparse candidate remains available for every MMA-evaluated operation.
Portable semantic geometry is distinct from device-specific physical projection bytes, padding, and schedules.
CE-GEO neither duplicates, certifies, nor blocks on CE-PTR; it revalidates shared interfaces after concurrent changes.
Immutable topology and mutable values retain independent identities, lifetimes, storage, and invalidation.
Every logical edge has exactly one semantic owner and exactly one physical contributing owner.
All feasible sm_70 foundation, implementation, validation, and evidence work completes before CE-AMP may begin.
Cellerator rearranges work only within the caller-supplied axis-qualified work window.
The Cellerator execution image is a versioned pointer-free relocatable IR with a projection directory; CPK1 v1 and CellShard CPEXEC01 compatibility remain explicit.
Boolean sequence logic, masks, events, segments, identities, and integer counts remain natural representations until a quantitative interaction; planning may choose materialization or fusion.
Immutable structure, semantic geometry, physical projections, mutable value planes, reusable prepared state, and per-launch bindings have separate identities and lifetimes.
Baseplane remains a separate sequence-engineering repository. CE-LIVE may consume its frozen interfaces but may not duplicate or relocate its general execution engine.
CPE2 remains pointer-free persistent execution IR. Typed activation is non-owning. CellShard transports opaque bytes and never selects kernels or interprets Cellerator projection semantics.
Correctness and adversarial validation precede timing. Kernel-only timing is not sufficient for promotion.
The quantitative PBMC3K fixture is for computational correctness and performance only. Missing biological provenance must remain visible and no scientific interpretation may be inferred.
Shape never establishes biological compatibility. Domain, exact order, geometry, partition, structure identity and epoch, and value generation remain explicit.

Changing dense pointers, output pointers, scalars, streams, transient workspace, value allocation address, or value generation does not rebuild immutable topology or require structural preparation unless a declared dependency changes.

No repeated native run path silently reconstructs CSR, BELL, COO, dense tensors, or canonical order. Conventional projections are legal only as explicit planner candidates with visible conversion cost.
Forward CP-BP relations use feature-or-gene source and row-or-cell destination. Transpose/backward shares logical edge identity and uses explicit orientation metadata.
Every source mutation occurs under a claimed task with a matching exclusive scope. Integration files are modified only by designated fan-in tasks.
Candidate selection uses complete cost, expected reuse, independent correctness, and a strong conventional fallback. Analytical models shortlist; empirical evidence decides uncertain cases.
Steady-state execution performs no hidden allocation, device selection, descriptor creation, structural hashing, host round trip, or device-wide synchronization.
Cellerator does not become an H5AD parser, archive owner, source service, network service, or CellShard replacement. Fixture parsing remains in test and benchmark tooling.
Tensor Core metadata and kernels remain architecture-specific projection and candidate state and never enter stable biological identity.
CelleraTorch never becomes the canonical allocator, parameter owner, planner, runtime, or implementation home for reusable Cellerator math.

Cellerator has one runtime substrate with structure-persistent, plan-persistent, and launch-transient allocation; prepared operations do not own their only stream and steady-state run performs no hidden allocation, discovery, hashing, device selection, or synchronization.

This recovery revision changes only todo-orchestrator planning state; CellShard, implementation, CMake, tests, benchmarks, runtime behavior, Git pointers, commits, pushes, claims, and resource leases remain untouched.
CellShard owns storage and neutral delivery metadata while Cellerator owns execution resources, collective policy, topology, scheduling, and Cellerator-specific placement.
Root CMake remains configuration-oriented, public targets and aliases remain stable unless proven unused, and CUDA targets do not consume module BMIs.
Authority documentation tells the post-remap truth, historical records remain historical, GlassHelix remains unfrozen, and canonical CE-LIVE harnesses require no temporary source edits.
Cellerator runtime is the sole native runtime authority; compatibility runtime use is explicit and current core does not depend on it accidentally.
Preserve frozen CE-ARCH and CE-LIVE contracts, numerical behavior, and current canonical physical ownership.

Validation distinguishes regressions from environment limits, current native targets do not link CP-Math v1 evidence, the reverse CellShard runtime dependency is absent, and both repositories finish committed, pushed, and clean.

CP-BP v1 tasks remain terminal; validated plans, reconstruction, tiles, CPK1, direct kernel, referees, tests, benchmarks, and CellShard loading are preserved through adapters until versioned replacements pass equivalent gates.
Semantic geometry is distinct from physical projection and no universal physical representation, operator geometry, matrix-wide format, or generic SpMM ontology is presumed.
CE-PTR-00 changes only durable context and todo coordination state; it performs no production implementation or opportunistic refactor.

Before any implementation claim inspect live CE-GEO tasks, scopes, locks, and interlocks; never duplicate or bypass CE-GEO ownership. Defer only overlapping files or sections and continue independent CE-PTR work. Consume compatible CE-GEO results without ideological rebuilds, and create cross-campaign dependencies only for genuine correctness needs.
Substantial construction exposes requirements before execution; prepared or sealed execution must not grow ownership, allocate unexpectedly, or discover capacity in the hot path.

For integer and index domains prefer direct indexing, packed keys, radix or counting sort, scans, adjacent compaction, offsets or CSR, generation marks, bitsets, fixed-width tables, and exact bounded flat tables before node-based generic containers.

Compiled or frozen structures converge on requirements queries, caller/session-provided bytes, versioned pointer-free images with relative offsets, validation, and typed rebound views; do not duplicate thawed owners when an image can supply the view.

Every material migration records the accidental representation, semantic structure, lifetime, bounds, memory domain, mutation pattern, final replacement, invariants, allocation behavior, validation, and performance evidence. Algorithmic redesign requires equivalence before old-path deletion; uncertain speedups are not claimed.
Do not introduce a generic vector, buffer, dynamic-array, or array-owner clone with general resize, reserve, or push semantics; prefer named domain structures.
CE-PTR may benchmark alternatives during development and select static or preparation-time policy, but must not add a continuously running runtime optimizer or hot-path benchmark tuner.

Low-level production Cellerator does not use shared_ptr as the lifetime mechanism for buffers, GPU allocations, index structures, or execution objects; adapters may retain externally required lifetime mechanisms.
No unspecified structure in production Cellerator: every material representation must name its semantic structure, ownership, lifetime, cardinality, mutation pattern, and memory domain.
Views never own; host, pinned-host, device, NUMA-host, external, persistent, plan-lifetime, graph-stable, and transient placement and lifetime remain explicit and separate.
Real fixed bounds such as top-K, fanout, block width, cache capacity, stream count, and warp width are represented physically rather than by unconstrained growable containers.

CellShard retains storage, persistence, transport, staging, and distribution ownership; BioPrep retains biological preprocessing policy and workflow orchestration; CelleraTorch remains a thin adapter. CE-PTR must not move those concerns back into Cellerator or make native Cellerator depend on Torch.
Composed GPU stages keep data resident; host materialization is an explicit terminal adapter and not an incidental ownership boundary.

Migrations preserve stable identities, canonical gene and row recovery, persistence compatibility, numerical semantics, and current execution contracts; grep-count reduction never outranks clarity, correctness, or measured behavior.
Tesla V100 sm_70 is the primary performance target; stable interfaces remain generation-conscious and portable, and CE-PTR does not depend on later sm_86 work.

Modern execution, the sole execution session, the CE-ARCH operation core, planner, CPE2, and native candidates remain authoritative. CP-Math v1 and legacy sparse APIs are compatibility or evidence only.

Validation reports distinguish pre-existing failures from remap regressions. The baseline default build failure at include/Cellerator/dist/nccl_communicator.cuh local_context visibility is recorded and may be removed only within canonical runtime consolidation without changing semantics.

Baseplane remains sequence engineering, CellShard remains persistence and delivery, GlassHelix remains scientific dynamics, and CelleraTorch remains optional framework adaptation. No speculative GlassHelix contract is frozen.
Canonical current code uses semantic Unix extensions: .c, .h, .cc, .hh, .ccm, .cu, .cuh, with .inl, .tcc, .inc, and .def only for their declared roles.
CellPack and CP-BP are Cellerator geometry compilation. Their validated algorithms and ABIs are preserved while their canonical physical home becomes include/Cellerator/geometry and src/geometry.
No public header under include/Cellerator includes a private path under src, and tests do not include implementation translation units.
C++20 modules are host-only semantic borders. CUDA translation units neither import modules nor depend on BMI consumption.
Every repository mutation after bootstrap occurs under a coding-workflow claim with matching exclusive scope; shared CMake and compatibility fan-in changes remain serial or integration-exclusive.

The remap changes physical ownership and build ownership only. Frozen CE-ARCH and CE-LIVE semantics, identities, numerical behavior, projection plurality, execution lifetimes, and candidate behavior remain unchanged.
Do not change execution_image_v2 schema, identity, checksum, build, validation, rebind, or prebind semantics.
Cellerator production include and src surfaces own in-memory computation and CPE2 semantics only; path-backed dataset access and CellShard transport integration live in CellShard.
Preserve the completed CE-BIOPREP-01 extraction, including all deletions, new generic sparse operators, tests, CMake changes, and documentation; do not edit BioPrep or recreate preprocessing APIs.
Implementation tasks route/slice with ctxpp, edit canonical source only, run focused gates, then refresh or lint the narrow route. Correctness and GPU efficiency outrank source density.

CP-MATH consumes the frozen PackingPlan, row-order, warp-tile/32-bit-mask, and CPK1 contracts. Any semantic or schema change requires todo interface revise under cpbp-interface-migration and persistent-payload-schema locks.
Do not add or vendor CUTLASS, CuTe, or another new external dependency without explicit user approval.
Backend comparisons use equivalent sparse/dense storage and accumulation semantics; an f16 native path is never promoted against an f32-only vendor baseline.

Cellerator/data/test/generated/csh5/dataset.csh5 is a 67.7 GB legacy CellShard artifact. Do not open, scan, map, validate, or benchmark it until CP-MATH-COMPLETE is reached and the user has granted explicit permission in the active session; you must ask the user for permission before opening it.

Reuse existing warp tiles and compact values. Native SpMM metadata is a sidecar; do not create a second native packed matrix, row permutation, or duplicate values without measured schema-revision evidence.
After an execution failure that may have partially written output, do not silently retry another backend.

PackingPlan contains durable data-derived structure only; PhysicalExecutionViews are derived; MathRequest has mathematics but no backend; ExecutionPlan is immutable pointer-free metadata; PreparedExecution owns live CUDA state.
Repeated PreparedExecution run calls perform no search, tuning, lowering, descriptor creation, general allocation/free, or reusable dense-RHS repacking.
No custom SpMM production promotion or final performance claim is legal without an accessible real biological CP-BP corpus and recorded representation/runtime distributions.
Canonical Cellerator source, focused tests, Git state, and live SQLite coordination state are authoritative; Markdown and .ctxpp views are projections or read-only retrieval artifacts.
Volta sm_70 on CUDA 12.x is a product target. Do not require a toolchain migration that drops SM70 without user approval.
Use cuSPARSE for conventional CSR/BELL, cuBLASLt for ordinary dense work, CUB for data movement primitives, and custom CUDA only for CellPack structure vendor APIs cannot express.
